pull_request.title: Fix race condition in event scheduler
pull_request.body:
This PR fixes a critical race condition that was causing events to be processed out of order.

## Problem
The event queue wasn't thread-safe, leading to occasional crashes under high load.

## Solution
- Added proper locking mechanism using `threading.Lock()`
- Implemented queue prioritization
- Added comprehensive tests

## Testing
- All existing tests pass
- Added 5 new test cases for concurrent scenarios
- Load tested with 1000 concurrent requests
